paragraphs.source_en: With Kindaichi tagging along after the chief, the detective led them into the dressing room adjoining the bathroom next to the kitchen. paragraphs.source_en: "You know, Chief," said the detective, looking at the two men, "we checked this house right after Také's murder, to see if that repatriated soldier who was staying at the Kashiwaya Inn might be hiding here.
